content:
Anthropic is rolling out a new update to how memory works across Claude Cowork and its chat feature, unifying the two systems' memory functions.

Claude Cowork memory is now live today.

Anthropic says: "Cowork now has memory, and it's the same memory you use when chatting, meaning you don't have to keep re-explaining things and can just pick up where you left off." It adds: "When Cowork is running tasks in the cloud, what Claude remembers from your chats shows up there, and vice versa."

Anthropic adds that memory for sensitive topics is off by default, but users can opt in.

They explain: "Claude won't, by default, put topics it considers sensitive — like health or personal beliefs — into memory; but if you don't want to have to re-explain those each time, you can turn it on in memory settings."

The company is supporting memory on both its free and paid plans, covering Mac and iOS platforms.

Anthropic says: "Memory is on by default for free, Pro, and Max plans on web, desktop, and mobile. Note that memory for sensitive topics is off by default. iOS and Android users should update to the latest version of the mobile app to get the latest features."
